items.summary: Recommendation: freeze incremental AI, infrastructure, third-party adoption, and revenue forecasts until finance-grade attribution and cost coverage are available. Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all $4.92 is an aggregate row with no site assignment; named site rows show $0 commission. AI usage cost is $921.96 across 5,093 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25, with 0 proven improvements and 2 measured outcomes marked inconclusive. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because periods do not align, site revenue is unattributed, and infrastructure, domain, labor, and other operating costs are absent. Approve report-only reconciliation work; authorize no new spend or monetization claims.

Pushback: impressions, clicks, sessions, SEO actions, repository stars, and opportunity scores are not financial outcomes. The fleet has 102 SEO actions, 13,811 impressions, 138 clicks, 984 sessions, and 15 conversions, but no attributable revenue or contribution margin is established. Do not use these metrics to justify forecasts, third-party adoption, or additional AI spend.
